captions: Shot 0 opens in a medium view of a small watch-repair workshop. An elderly watchmaker with a neatly trimmed silver-gray beard, thick dark eyebrows, round brass-rimmed glasses, and a small dark mole on his left cheekbone sits at a cluttered wooden bench under a warm tungsten desk lamp. He wears a deep-green wool vest over a cream shirt and a brown leather apron, and he leans toward an open pocket watch resting on a felt pad while shelves of antique clocks fill the wall behind him.

Shot 1 cuts to a tight close-up of the watchmaker's face. The tungsten lamp rakes across his silver-gray beard and thick dark eyebrows, the small mole on his left cheekbone is clearly visible, and a jeweler's loupe is clipped to his round brass-rimmed glasses as his eyes track a tiny gear he lifts with tweezers.

Shot 2 switches to an overhead view looking straight down at the wooden bench. The watchmaker's weathered hands arrange screwdrivers, a felt pad, brass gears, and the open pocket watch, while the edge of his brown leather apron and deep-green vest sleeve enter the frame under the warm lamp light.

Shot 3 moves to a side profile at bench height. The bearded watchmaker slowly winds the pocket watch crown between thumb and forefinger, his round glasses catching a glint from the tungsten lamp while ticking wall clocks hang softly blurred behind his silver-gray beard and cream shirt collar.

Shot 4 pulls back to a wide view of the workshop. The watchmaker in his deep-green vest and brown apron remains seated at the pool of warm lamp light, surrounded by wooden shelves crowded with antique clocks, hanging pendulums, and labeled drawers of parts stretching into the dim edges of the room.

Shot 5 cuts to an extreme close-up of the watch movement on the felt pad. The watchmaker's fingers guide fine tweezers to seat a tiny brass gear among the coils and jewels, the cream shirt cuff and the apron edge steady against the bench while the tungsten light picks out every scratch on the bench surface.

Shot 6 frames the scene over the watchmaker's shoulder from behind. Past his silver-gray hair and the strap of his brown leather apron, the open pocket watch sits centered in the lamp light, and his reflection with round brass-rimmed glasses appears faintly in a glass-front clock cabinet across the bench. Maintain invariant: The watchmaker wears round brass-rimmed glasses, not black-rimmed ones.

Shot 7 finishes in a steady medium view. The elderly watchmaker with the silver-gray beard, thick dark eyebrows, and mole on his left cheekbone lifts the reassembled pocket watch to his ear, listens, and gives a small satisfied smile as he sets it down on the felt pad under the warm tungsten lamp.
